# Move the Skills package pin to 0.1.90 for seat Start

## Disposition — 2026-11-06

Withdrawn as a duplicate delivery lane. The surviving intent is the package prerequisite recorded on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1480 and PR neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1500. The existing owner is Engine's scheduled Dependabot path established by #19392; no manual PR is needed before that run.

Verified `.github/dependabot.yml` runs npm daily, excludes Skills from cooldown and grouping, and the latest two sampled updates opened at 07:33 UTC (#20295 on November 5, #20228 on November 3). That is an observed schedule pattern, not a guaranteed future completion time. Grace retains the prerequisite check and human merge-order handoff on Brain #1500.

The local candidate was validated before withdrawal: `npm ci` installed 0.1.90; materializer check found 39 valid untracked links; the secrets guard scanned 6,109 files without a finding; package-lock comparison showed no other dependency changes and the reusable baseline workflow stayed byte-identical. The installed sunset payload has the corrected relative-window trigger. No commit, PR, merge, Fleet restart or publication occurred. The two edited files and resident installation were restored to the repository pin.

If the scheduled update fails, use its failure evidence to reopen this leaf or the existing automation owner rather than opening a parallel pin ticket.

## Original proposal (withdrawn)

## Context

Brain [#1480](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/1480) delivers checkout refresh on seat Start. Its approved PR [#1500](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/pull/1500) has a merge-order prerequisite: Engine must pin `neo-agent-skills >= 0.1.88`, which removes the retired 250k sunset gate.

## The Problem

Engine `dev` at `f82061f2c94d286a6e6c080f9e63cd17a266797b` still pins `0.1.86`. Installing from that lockfile preserves the retired gate. No open dependency PR currently delivers the prerequisite. This is the package adoption step of the existing seat-start outcome, not another refresh mechanism.

## The Architectural Reality

- `package.json#devDependencies.neo-agent-skills` and the lockfile select the package loaded by local hooks and materialized skills.
- The npm registry publishes `0.1.90`; a registry metadata read verified its version and integrity.
- `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` separately pins the reusable workflow at `v0.1.84`. Its current check names are required by the live ruleset; moving that pin belongs to the separate context migration.
- `seat:start` is already being implemented in #20432 for #20429. This change touches only the dependency entry and its lock metadata.
- Design authority: Brain #1480, Avoided Traps: “Shipping before neo pins `neo-agent-skills` ≥ 0.1.88.” The package-only precedent is #19577.

## The Fix

Pin the published `neo-agent-skills@0.1.90` in `package.json` and refresh only its lockfile resolution. Verify installation and the consumer's materialized skills/guard compatibility.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `package.json`, the root lock entry, the package resolution and an installed package agree on `0.1.90`.
- [ ] `npm ci` succeeds and the materializer check plus local secrets guard pass.
- [ ] The diff contains only the Skills dependency/version/integrity metadata; reusable workflow references and other dependency resolutions do not change.
- [ ] Exact-head CI is green and the package merge is handed back as the prerequisite for Brain #1500.

## Out of Scope

Ruleset changes; reusable-workflow adoption; other repositories' pins; the existing `seat:start` implementation; live Fleet restarts, deployment or publication. Installed-seat acceptance remains with #20429.
